 <section id="20e78d2c" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="7069a920" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="3992c5f2" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="51c6a927" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="widget_t0s" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="2153448554"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="2153448554" style=""> <h1 class="t-text-align-center m-text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.1;"><span style="display: unset; color: rgb(114, 115, 118);">Pousada em Ibiraquera, SC</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h1> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="879b9b73" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1177117779"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1177117779" style=""> <h2 class="t-text-align-center m-text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.1;"><span style="display: initial;">Pousada Raia 1<br/></span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="8d9e2366" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1406598808"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1406598808" style=""><p class="text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;">H&aacute; lugares no mundo que s&atilde;o especiais e a Pousada Raia 1 &eacute; um desses lugares, por estar estrat&eacute;gicamente localizada de frente para o mar e a lagoa de Ibiraquera, onde eventualmente a lagoa se encontra com o mar formando um rio de &aacute;guas cristalinas.</span></p><p class="text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;">O caf&eacute; da manh&atilde; al&eacute;m de ser delicioso &eacute; servido em um espa&ccedil;o privilegiado com vista para o mar e lagoa.</span></p><p class="text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;">Para os amantes do esporte temos Guarderia onde podem deixar seu equipamento de Windsurf, Kitesurf e SUP.</span></p><p class="text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p class="text-align-justify" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;">Venham conferir e sejam bem vindos!<br/></span></p></div> 
</div>

 <section id="8ba5cc3d" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="9ef3d819" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid="" data-parallax="true" data-parallax-velocity="0.2"> <div id="785fb6ed" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="cedca9c6" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="2663c7eb" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1233815483"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1233815483" style=""><p class="text-align-center"><strong style="font-weight: 600; display: unset;">&Aacute;REAS COMUNS</strong></p></div> 
</div> 
 <div id="4b29186a" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1628732316"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1628732316" style=""> <h3 class="text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.1;"><span style="display: unset; color: rgb(114, 115, 118);">CONHE&Ccedil;A NOSSA ESTRUTURA</span></h3> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="3495b807" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1114475237"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1114475237" style=""><p class="text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;">Al&eacute;m de nossas confort&aacute;veis acomoda&ccedil;&otilde;es e da localiza&ccedil;&atilde;o privilegiada, pr&oacute;xima &agrave; praia e &agrave; lagoa, a Pousada Raia 1 oferece espa&ccedil;os pensados para voc&ecirc; aproveitar cada momento da sua estadia.</span></p><p style="line-height: 1.5;" class="text-align-center"><span style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;">Nosso jardim interno, cercado por muito verde e natureza, conta com um</span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial; font-weight: bold;">espa&ccedil;o gourmet</strong><span style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;">completo e</span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial; font-weight: bold;">churrasqueira</strong><span style="display: initial;">, criando o ambiente perfeito para reunir a fam&iacute;lia e os amigos, preparar uma boa refei&ccedil;&atilde;o e aproveitar momentos especiais juntos.<span class="ql-cursor">﻿</span></span></p></div>

 <div id="widget_opa" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="3147338999"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="3147338999" style=""><p class="text-align-center m-text-align-center"><span style="font-weight: 600; display: unset; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">ACOMODA&Ccedil;&Otilde;ES</span></p></div> 
</div> 
 <div id="291aa2ab" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1556727366"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1556727366" style=""> <h3 class="text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.1;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: unset; font-weight: normal;">CONFORTO E QUALIDADE</span></h3> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="62c80772" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1493471181"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1493471181" style=""><p class="text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial; color: var(--color_3);">A Pousada Raia 1 disp&otilde;e de 10 acomoda&ccedil;&otilde;es, pensadas para oferecer conforto e praticidade durante sua estadia.</span></p><p class="text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial; color: var(--color_3);"><span style="display: initial; color: var(--color_3);">S&atilde;o 7 acomoda&ccedil;&otilde;es de frente para o mar e a lagoa,</span> 
</span><span style="display: initial; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color_3);">Super Luxo e Luxo</span><span style="display: initial; color: var(--color_3);"><span style="display: initial; color: var(--color_3);">, e 3 acomoda&ccedil;&otilde;es integradas ao jardim,</span> 
</span><span style="display: initial; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color_3);">Standard e Fam&iacute;lia</span><span style="display: initial; color: var(--color_3);">, sem vista para o mar.</span></p><p class="text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial; color: var(--color_3);">Todas as acomoda&ccedil;&otilde;es contam com Wi-Fi, camas King-size com len&ccedil;&oacute;is, toalhas, TV, ar-condicionado e estacionamento.</span></p><p class="text-align-center" style="line-height: 1.1;"><br/></p></div> 
</div>
